name: Edward Warchocki booking (MERA Robotics)
description: Books Edward Warchocki, a humanoid robot (Unitree G1) and influencer run by MERA Robotics, for events across Europe: availability, event planning, quotes and booking inquiries. This agent is served by the MERA Robotics MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no A2A JSON-RPC endpoint): connect an MCP client to https://merarobotics.com/mcp. Server card: https://merarobotics.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.

provider.organization: MERA Robotics (MERA ROBOTICS sp. z o.o.)

skills.name: Check Edward's availability
skills.description: Checks whether Edward Warchocki or another MERA humanoid robot is available on a date and in a country (MCP tool check_availability).

skills.name: Plan a robot for an event
skills.description: Suggests how Edward can take part in a conference, trade fair, gala or corporate event (MCP tool plan_event_robot).

skills.name: Get a rental quote
skills.description: Returns a quote for renting a humanoid robot with operators from MERA RENT (MCP tool get_rental_quote). Edward Warchocki is quoted individually through an inquiry.

skills.name: Send a booking inquiry for Edward
skills.description: Sends an inquiry to the MERA Robotics team after the user has confirmed the details (MCP tools request_quote, open_inquiry_form, start_booking).

skills.name: Media coverage and references
skills.description: Lists media coverage and references of Edward Warchocki and MERA Robotics (MCP tool get_media_and_proof).
